prompt: A company claims half of its customers are repeat buyers. In a random sample of $100$ customers, $56$ are repeat buyers. For the test of $H_0: p = 0.5$, what is the value of the test statistic $z = \frac{\hat{p} - p_0}{\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)/n}}$?
hint: Use $p_0 = 0.5$ (the null value) in the standard deviation, not $\hat{p}$.

hints.text: Use $p_0 = 0.5$ (the null value) in the standard deviation, not $\hat{p}$.

explanation: $z = (0.56 - 0.50)/0.05 = 1.2$: the sample proportion is 1.2 standard deviations above the claimed value.

alternativeExplanations.title: In counts
steps: Under $H_0$, you expect 50 repeat buyers with SD $\sqrt{100(0.5)(0.5)} = 5$.
